privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: How we protect your creative data and privacy in the digital age.
privacy.dataCollectionBody: At Shapely, we collect minimal data required to provide a seamless sculpting experience. This includes account information provided during registration and metadata related to your interaction with our editor.
privacy.aiDataUsageBody: Your AI-generated prompts and sculpted texts are encrypted and used only to refine your personal models. We never sell your creative output.
privacy.securityBody: We employ industry-standard AES-256 encryption for all data at rest and TLS 1.3 for data in transit. Our infrastructure is regularly audited to maintain SOC2 compliance, ensuring your intellectual property remains yours alone.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: Shapely integrates with essential workflow tools. We only share data with these partners when you explicitly enable the integration:
privacy.contactBody: Our dedicated privacy team is here to help you understand how your data is handled. We typically respond within 24 hours.
privacy.footer: © 2023 Shapely AI Technologies. All rights reserved.
